items.text: Hey everyone! We've just released a new update that brings a new voice chat overhaul (making it near bulletproof) along with tons of other bug fixes and level balancing/difficulty tweaks.

If you played the game during this week or the last and encountered bugs or unbalanced gameplay, I encourage you to give it another try this weekend as almost all of our reported bugs have been fixed!
Thanks for playing, giving feedback, and sharing this game with your friends, we are committed to making this the best multiplayer experience on Steam!
Also, we pushed 5 other smaller patches this past week, so if you don't see a bug you encountered in this change list, it was probably already fixed!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43037843/72a2f8ea6d565b780cd511bb47bb3d58851087e8.png"]

Hi guys! We've been hard at work making improvements to the game every hour. We sincerely thank you all for putting BET at #21 in the Steam Global best seller rankings!!! Our mission is to create the best co-op game on Steam for you all, and while we have a long way to go, we appreciate the support. Lots more fixes coming this week, posting bugs in our Discord is super super helpful, we will fix them as fast as we can.
Shop Prices Now Scale Up Further When Playing With More Players
Fire Sale Now Lasts 30 Seconds (Up From 15)
Grocery Items and Grabbables Are Now Picked Up With a Press Interact Instead of a Hold
Updated Exit to Tease New Level

Fix Frame Drop When Day First Starts
Each Scooter Now Spawns in a Random Color
You Can Now Look Back Further While Riding

Hi Everyone! We've been working all hours of the day since the update to adjust the difficulty of the new Level 232 and fix any bugs introduced in the update. Note: For those of you who are unable to join/host any lobby due to "Connection Timeout" there is a good chance your date/time is not set correctly on your PC. We are currently working on a way to warn users when their time is not set properly as this will prohibit joining or hosting. But, in the mean time, check your windows time settings if you are experiencing connection timeouts!
